item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the video. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for the first step, so nothing was created and no download link exists.

**Where it stopped:** Magic Hour's talking-photo tool needs an audio file, so the first step was turning your script into speech. I asked for your exact line in English with "Ashley," a friendly female preset voice (not a clone of yours). The account turned it down for insufficient credits. That speech job costs about 8 credits (0.1 credit per character), and the 8-second video afterwards would cost more.

**What I'd use once you have credits:**
- **Voice:** Ashley (cv-0001), saying exactly: "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new."
- **Video:** your portrait animated to speak that audio, 8 seconds long, at 480p (the free-plan maximum).
- **Square:** your photo is already 1024×1024, so the video should come out square.
- **Captions:** none.

**To go ahead:** add credits to the account, either by buying a credit pack or upgrading the plan, or wait for your free credits to refill. Then tell me and I'll run both steps and send you the download link. If you'd rather hear the voice first, you can listen to Ashley's sample here: https://videos.magichour.ai/presets/voices/v2/cv-0001-ashley.mp3
